hints.title: Positive Conjunction Condition
hints.text: For the bitwise conjunction of chosen numbers to exceed zero, there must exist at least one bit position where every chosen candidate has a 1.

hints.title: Independent Bit Column Counts
hints.text: For each bit position b from 0 to 24 (since candidates <= 10^7 < 2^24), count how many numbers have their b-th bit set.

hints.title: Maximum Bit Frequency
hints.text: The largest group that shares a 1 at bit b has size equal to the total count of numbers with bit b set.

hints.title: Bit Position Tally Implementation

complexity.notes: Testing 25 bit positions takes linear time in total.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate proves that picking all numbers having bit b set is always optimal for that bit.
